reason: I already have ChatGPT, Make and HubSpot wired together, so 'AI co-workers' sounds like a wrapper around things I can build myself. I might poke at the free plan, but I wouldn't pay 99 € a month this month.
objection: I can't see what 100 credits actually buys me or which integrations exist beyond 'CRM, Google, Microsoft', so I can't tell if it does more than my own Zapier plus ChatGPT setup.
would_change_my_mind: A public integrations list with native HubSpot and Make support, plus a clear breakdown of what one credit does, showing it saves me hours my current stack doesn't.
